name: 993 Turbo exhaust heat exchangers, left and right (PicoGK concept)
material_candidate: IN625 LPBF (concept assumption; an IN625 aftermarket offer is recorded, the OEM material is not)
picogk_enhancement: Concept base model of the two mirrored heat exchangers: per bank three primaries from lobed per-port flanges, fanned into lanes so they pass clear, converging into a collector cone that S-bends outboard to a two-bolt turbine-side flange; the merge sits in a bulging heater jacket open at both ends for the heating air and joined to the gas tubes by staggered pin fins, so the air gap is one drained channel. The PET record is identity only: every dimension, the routing and every interface are assumptions. The heating-air connections, sealing rings and the heating tube of 202-10 are not modelled. The two ties only hold the pair together for display.

cylinder_pitch_mm.note: port spacing along the crankshaft; the M64 cylinder pitch is unpublished (M64-ACQ-0004); 118 mm is the Type 912 spacing in docs/research/917-german-engineering-sources.md, used as an order of magnitude

primary_bore_mm.note: PRIMARY_INNER_DIAMETER_MM of the F0 IN625 manifold study (parts/993-eng-exhaust-manifold-in625-f0-0001), itself a hypothesis

collector_bore_mm.note: COLLECTOR_INNER_DIAMETER_MM of the F0 IN625 manifold study, itself a hypothesis

lane_offset_mm.note: lateral lane of the front and rear primaries so the three pass each other clear before the merge

lane_z_mm.note: depth of the primary lanes below the port faces

merge_x_mm.note: merge point of the three primaries along X

collector_bend_start_x_mm.note: start of the collector S-bend toward the turbine

collector_outboard_mm.note: outboard offset of the outlet; turbine position unknown

collector_rise_mm.note: rise of the outlet toward the turbine

stud_offset_mm.note: two studs per port at +/-31 mm along X; no stud pattern published (head torque 28 Nm in the manual gives no geometry)

stud_hole_mm.note: M8 clearance; the PET lists M8 lock nuts at 202-10

jacket_start_x_mm.note: front (air inlet) end of the heater jacket

jacket_end_x_mm.note: rear (air outlet) end of the heater jacket, kept on the straight collector run

jacket_front_radius_mm.note: jacket inner radius at its front end, clear of the converging primaries

jacket_rear_radius_mm.note: jacket inner radius at its rear end around the collector

pin_diameter_mm.note: pin-fin diameter (heat transfer to the heating air, and the ties that make the jacket one body with the tubes)

pins_per_ring.note: pins per ring, staggered by half a step ring to ring

display_bank_offset_mm.note: display half-spacing between the two mirrored units; not the engine's bank spacing

tie_radius_mm.note: display tie radius; the ties hold the pair as one body and are not part of either heat exchanger

fillet_mm.note: outer fillet of the merge crotch, flange roots and ties

open_interfaces: cylinder-head exhaust port positions, bores, flange faces and stud pattern
heating-air inlet and outlet connections and the heating tube
sealing rings and lock nuts of 202-10
thermal growth between the heads and the turbochargers
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
